note: Twin of orbital-server tests/read_access.rs. Every case is pending: the dispatch chain is covered by server-dispatch, the entity read-policy scoping needs the viewer-aware fetch. request/expected record the Rust request and expected host fetch result. Replay limits found: the entity round-trips between steps without its bytes type, so DISPATCH_RUN cannot be asserted after the request is stored (preparedExpect records the intended DISPATCH_PREPARED); a RESPOND payload expectation (requestId, status) does not match even when the event is emitted, so expectedResponse records the intended status and the step asserts only that RESPOND is emitted.
